categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main segments: the research, development, production, and sales of liquid crystal display (LCD) and touch display modules, and the manufacturing and sales of electromagnetic wires. Its products include LCD screens, LCD modules, capacitive touch screens, full lamination touch display modules, protective glass covers, and various copper and aluminum wires, serving industries such as power, automotive displays, home electronics, medical devices, and industrial control.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies in LCD and touch display module manufacturing, including full lamination processes and integration of touch functions. It also utilizes specialized production methods for electromagnetic wires, including copper and aluminum wire manufacturing with proprietary technology for high-end products. The company emphasizes customized production based on customer orders, with rigorous quality control and continuous process improvements, including R&D in new display technologies and materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global Fortune 500 companies and well-known industry players such as Walmart, Belkin, Flextronics, Jabil, Desay SV, Honeywell, and others. The products serve diverse markets including automotive displays, home electronics, medical equipment, industrial control, and power sectors. The company has a strong presence in both domestic and international markets, with significant sales in the US, Europe, and Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and major production facilities in Tianjin, Shenzhen, Hunan, Jiangsu, and other provinces. It has established overseas sales subsidiaries in the United States, Hong Kong, and a production base in Malaysia to serve global markets. Its sales are distributed across the US, Europe (notably the UK, France, Germany), and Asian regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly of display modules and electromagnetic wires. It procures raw materials such as integrated circuits, TFT LCD panels, flexible printed circuits, and metals, and delivers finished products directly to end customers or through agents. The company also engages in hedging activities to manage raw material price risks.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on technological innovation and R&D to enhance product competitiveness and expand market share. Key R&D initiatives include development of reflective color e-paper displays, specialized driver chips for bistable LCDs, automotive lidar lenses, multi-language user interface screens, and advanced electromagnetic wire products for new energy and power applications. The company invests significantly in talent development and aims to strengthen its innovation capabilities and product portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of manufactured products, including LCD and touch display modules and electromagnetic wires. The company follows a customer order-driven production model, with sales contracts denominated in multiple currencies for international transactions. It also earns government subsidies and engages in hedging activities that impact financial results.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as one of the leading domestic manufacturers in the touch display and electromagnetic wire sectors, with strong competitive advantages in technology, quality, and customer service. It competes with both domestic and international firms, leveraging its integrated service offerings and global customer base. Its subsidiaries are recognized as professional manufacturers with stable relationships with top-tier clients.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.26 billion, a slight decrease of 5.03% from the previous year, but achieved a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 21.46 million, reversing prior losses. Total assets stood at RMB 4.53 billion with a slight decline, while net assets increased marginally. The company has shown a recovery trend with improved profitability and positive cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product quality, stable performance, and comprehensive one-stop service from design to final product delivery. It differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, customized production, and rapid response to customer needs. Its integrated solutions and continuous innovation in display and electromagnetic wire technologies provide customers with competitive, high-value products tailored to diverse applications.
